title: STRONGEST_HACKING_STACK_2026
universal_lens: The offensive-security stack is a directed acyclic graph (DAG) of state-transition operators. Each tool acts as a linear map over the target's configuration space, systematically reducing epistemic entropy from initial reconnaissance to final domain persistence, constrained by hardware limits and ethical boundary conditions.
gsi_mapping: GSI models this pipeline as a sequential Bayesian update. Initial OSINT establishes priors; active probing yields likelihoods that collapse uncertainty into high-confidence vulnerability states. Conformal prediction intervals bound the success probability of payload delivery, ensuring rigorous statistical calibration before any exploitation attempt.
gse_mapping: GSE treats the arsenal as a Markov Decision Process (MDP). The agent transitions through discrete states—reconnaissance, mapping, cracking, owning—maximizing a reward function defined by persistent access. Hardware constraints (e.g., lack of CUDA on mobile) act as strict transition veto gates in the policy network.
